Description:
Syden is a place to talk with your friends by voice, video and text. Voice rooms that are always open, screen sharing with sound, chat with emojis and sounds — everything a group needs to play together, watch together or just hang out and talk.

Truly free
There is no paid plan, no subscription and no locked item waiting for payment. Profile decorations are all free. Anyone who contributes does so because they want to — and already had access to everything before that.

No ads, no selling your data
Syden has no ads, doesn't sell your data and doesn't use your conversations for anything other than delivering them to the people you're talking to. Voice, video and shared screens are not recorded.

Made for groups, not crowds
Communities are invite-only. You choose who's in, and every community has its own channels, emojis and sounds. You can block anyone who bothers you, report anything that's wrong and leave whenever you like, taking your data with you.

What's inside
• Voice rooms with video and screen sharing with sound
• Noise suppression that muffles fans and background noise
• Chat with attachments, replies, threads and polls
• Emojis and sounds made by the community itself
• Karaoke, soundboard and voice effects
• Private messages and a friends list
• Session mode, to watch together with the chat alongside
• A pixel art home: the bunny's room, by day and by night
• Light and dark themes, in 70+ languages

Syden works in the browser and in this app, with the same account.
ShortDescription: Voice, video and chat for your group of friends. Always-open rooms, screen sharing with sound and emojis made by the community itself. Truly free: no ads, no subscription and nothing locked away waiting for payment.
ReleaseNotes: New noise suppression that runs right on your computer and muffles fans and background noise. A new icon, the new pixel art home — the bunny's room — and Syden in 70+ languages.
